name: Emerson Siega
title: Senior Flutter Engineer
headlineTitle: I build software that is *simple*, useful, and made to last.
headlineText: Hello, I’m Emerson — a Brazilian Senior Flutter Engineer with over 16 years of experience, focused on building reliable digital products, thoughtful architectures, and experiences that feel effortless to use.
aboutDescription:
I’m passionate about turning complex problems into clear, maintainable software. I work across product and engineering to shape Flutter apps that are technically sound and genuinely useful.

I care about clean architecture, collaborative teams, and the details that make products dependable. My favorite work pairs pragmatic decisions with high standards for quality.
